youtube_title: Jesus... Why Do I Hate Every Photo Of Myself? | Psalm 149:4 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? My friend posted one tonight and I made her delete it.

Her friend posted a photo from tonight and she made her delete it. Everyone else looked fine. She kept zooming in on her own face.

Her: Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? My friend posted one tonight and I made her delete it.

Her: Everyone else looked fine. I just kept zooming in on my face.

Jesus: You looked at that photo the way you'd never look at a friend. You went searching for something wrong.

Her: Because something is wrong. I'm not pretty like them.

Jesus: You've compared yourself to filters and angles for so long that your real face started to feel like a mistake. It isn't.

Her: Easy for You to say. You don't have to see me in the mirror.

Jesus: I see you every day. And I'm not disappointed. I delight in you, the same face you keep trying to hide.

"For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory."
Psalms 149:4 (NIV)

Jesus: Before the mirror tomorrow, remember who's already smiling at you.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

What would you tell a friend who hated her own photos? 🙏 Tell us in the comments.
